Question: default vs static method
Answer:
• Default methods are inherited by implementation classes to support backward compatibility, while static methods belong strictly to the interface and cannot be overridden
  • Key Differences
    • Instance vs. Class: Default methods require an object instance to run. Static methods are called directly using the interface name
    • Inheritance: Default methods are inherited by classes and can be overridden. Static methods are not inherited by implementation classes or subclasses
    • Multiple Inheritance Conflict: If a class implements two interfaces with the exact same default method, the class must override and resolve the conflict. This is not an issue for static methods because they are never inherited
